envVariables.description: Workflow run by the shared image.

Embedding backend. openai_compatible: an embedding server such as vLLM or Ollama (set the URL and model below). hashing: offline word hashing, only for checking that a job runs; its frames are not meaningful.
URL of the OpenAI-compatible embedding server, ending in /v1. Must be reachable from the compute node.
Embedding model name served at that URL.
Optional chat model to name frames. none: frames are named by their distinctive keywords. openai_compatible: a chat server (set the URL and model below).
URL of the OpenAI-compatible chat server, ending in /v1.
Chat model name served at that URL.
Upper bound on the number of frames. Small collections get fewer.
Passage length in words. Each passage is assigned to one frame.
Frames with fewer passages are folded into the nearest frame.
How frames map onto the backbone. embedding: by meaning, using the embedding server. legacy or subdiscipline_aware: by matching frame terms to backbone terms.
Frames that match no backbone domain. keep: reported under Uncategorized. drop: given weight 0.
JSON list of file name patterns to include, e.g. ["*Brown_Bag*"].
Maximum number of files to read from the corpus folder.
Skip files with fewer characters of text than this.
Also write one backbone figure per document.

fileInputs.name: Corpus

fileInputs.name: Science backbone (JSON)

fileInputs.name: Job configuration (YAML)

notes.label: Semantic Sensemaking: narrative frames
notes.helpText: Splits a folder of documents into passages, groups passages that discuss similar things into narrative frames, names each frame, and places the frames on a science backbone. Writes CSV tables, the frames as an editable dictionary (frames_lexicon.json) for the dictionary app, interactive HTML figures, a Markdown summary, and a manifest. Needs an embedding server.
